boot.slowBody.en: This is taking longer than usual. Keep this screen open while your village loads.
boot.slowBody.text: Èyí ń pẹ́ ju bí ó ṣe máa ń pẹ́ lọ. Fi ojú-ìwé yìí sílẹ̀ ní ṣíṣí nígbà tí abúlé rẹ ń ṣí.

boot.unsupportedBody.en: Update your browser or Android System WebView, then try again. Your saved village stays on this device.
boot.unsupportedBody.text: Ṣe àtúnṣe aṣàwákiri rẹ tàbí Android System WebView, lẹ́yìn náà gbìyànjú lẹ́ẹ̀kan sí i. Abúlé rẹ tí a fi pamọ́ wà lórí ẹ̀rọ yìí.

boot.languageError.en: Your language could not be loaded. Check your connection and try again.
boot.languageError.text: A kò lè ṣí èdè rẹ. Ṣàyẹ̀wò ìsopọ̀ rẹ kí o sì gbìyànjú lẹ́ẹ̀kan sí i.

common.unknownError.en: The action could not be completed. Please try again.
common.unknownError.text: A kò lè parí iṣẹ́ náà. Jọ̀wọ́ gbìyànjú lẹ́ẹ̀kan sí i.

boot.missing.en: This browser is missing: {detail}. Update your phone (iOS 15 or later) or your browser (Chrome, Safari, Edge or Firefox from 2021 or later), then open Kagemura again.
boot.missing.text: Aṣàwákiri yìí kò ní: {detail}. Ṣe àtúnṣe fóònù rẹ (iOS 15 tàbí èyí tí ó tẹ̀lé e) tàbí aṣàwákiri rẹ (Chrome, Safari, Edge tàbí Firefox láti 2021 tàbí lẹ́yìn rẹ̀), lẹ́yìn náà ṣí Kagemura lẹ́ẹ̀kan sí i.

boot.realSlow.en: Kagemura is taking a long time to load
boot.realSlow.text: Kagemura ń pẹ́ jù láti ṣí

boot.realSlowBody.en: Nothing has moved for a while. It keeps loading in the background, or you can start again.
boot.realSlowBody.text: Kò sí ohun tí ó yí padà fún ìgbà díẹ̀. Ó ń bá ṣíṣí lọ lẹ́yìn, tàbí o lè bẹ̀rẹ̀ lẹ́ẹ̀kan sí i.

boot.failureBody.en: Check your connection and try again. Your village is saved on this device.
boot.failureBody.text: Ṣàyẹ̀wò ìsopọ̀ rẹ kí o sì gbìyànjú lẹ́ẹ̀kan sí i. A ti fi abúlé rẹ pamọ́ sórí ẹ̀rọ yìí.

boot.retrying.text: À ń gbìyànjú lẹ́ẹ̀kan sí i…

boot.description.en: Kagemura: Ninja Clans. Build a hidden mountain village, train warriors, and raid rival strongholds.
boot.description.text: Kagemura: Ìdílé Ninja. Kọ́ abúlé àṣírí lórí òkè, dá àwọn jagunjagun lẹ́kọ̀ọ́, kí o sì gbógun ti ibi olódi àwọn abánidíje.

boot.pwaDescription.en: Lead a ninja clan: build a hidden mountain village, train warriors, and raid rival strongholds with smoke and sabotage.
boot.pwaDescription.text: Darí ìdílé ninja: kọ́ abúlé àṣírí lórí òkè, dá àwọn jagunjagun lẹ́kọ̀ọ́, kí o sì gbógun ti ibi olódi àwọn abánidíje pẹ̀lú èéfín àti ìbàjẹ́ àṣírí.
